source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Τριάντα Οκτώ Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and enumerates nobody, so this is one entry and not thirty-eight. It is not the corpus's `thirty-eight-martyrs-of-thrace`, who are kept by the Greek church on 23 August and died by the sword; these thirty-eight were shut into a bath-house. The page gives no year, no reign and no place, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. No hymn is printed.
